verdict.rationale: SumUp docs explicitly describe embedding payment acceptance directly in iOS/Android apps via Reader SDKs, controlling the reader over Bluetooth or using Tap to Pay, and offline transactions support, covering the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit named SDK package/repo links for iOS/Android (e.g. CocoaPods/Gradle artifacts), independent developer corroboration of SDK integration experience, and detailed API reference docs beyond high-level descriptions.
